items.source_excerpt: من المهم من المجتمع أن ينشرون الأدلة أو المخاطر بين بعضهم البعض
items.rationale: The structural five-verbs-shaped transformation is locally plausible, but the intended subject is singular (المجتمع), so plural ينشروا is not licensed. The event demonstrates that nun-change shape alone cannot establish grammatical correctness.
